name: SceneMap

provenance.detector: Bright connected-component centroids from actual image pixels
provenance.correspondence: Epipolar row distance and positive disparity with Hungarian assignment
provenance.triangulation: Linear DLT/SVD with positive-depth and reprojection checks
provenance.evaluation: Generated world coordinates used only after estimation

limitations: Owned generated pinhole stereo fixtures, not real-camera or learned-model validation.
Correspondence assumes rectified calibration and distinctive vertical positions; difficult epipolar ambiguity remains unsolved.
Identical-colored objects are detected from pixels; world identities are not estimator inputs.
Baseline scale error can leave reprojection error small while reconstructed distances are wrong.
Unsynchronized pairs produce no reconstructed points; missing observations are not silently interpolated.
Identity-switch evaluation associates estimated positions with ground truth per frame and is not a standard MOT benchmark.
Twelve frames per scenario are deterministic fixtures, not evidence of generalization.
